issues.where: Io's shadow at the terminator, right of centre (crops E and I in image-06, P in image-07)
issues.what: the shadow is a hard-edged black oval that runs past the terminator into the night side and shows up as a darker blob on an already dark limb. It reads as a sticker pasted over the shading, not a shadow cast onto cloud
issues.fix: project the shadow onto the sphere so it stretches and fades with the terminator, give it a soft penumbra, and hide it where it falls on the night side

issues.where: southern limb and south polar region (crops S and T in image-04)
issues.what: the south cap turns into a smeared, desaturated brown-grey surface with crater-like ovals. It looks like a rocky moon texture rather than Jovian cloud bands, and the detail is much softer than in the equatorial bands
issues.fix: carry the banded cloud texture with festoons and small ovals to the pole at matching resolution, and avoid crater-like rimmed spots

issues.where: southern limb (crops T and U in image-08)
issues.what: the same soft, low-detail pole with crater-like spots, plus a bright rim along the lower limb where the night side meets space. The lighting band ends in a fairly hard line
issues.fix: use the same polar texture fix, and make the limb glow fall off smoothly into the night side

issues.where: Milky Way at the far right edge (crop W in image-08, crop F in image-06)
issues.what: two round, opaque black blobs in the bright star cloud look like holes or stamped artifacts, not dust lanes
issues.fix: remove the blobs or turn them into irregular, wispy dust lanes

issues.where: Io in both frames (crop A in image-02, crop P in image-07)
issues.what: Io has a smooth, plastic, airbrushed look with blotchy spots and little surface detail at native size
issues.fix: add finer surface detail, sharper volcanic features and a slight limb darkening

issues.where: cloud bands across the disk (crops A, I, J, N)
issues.what: the turbulent swirls are painterly and slightly airbrushed, with some soft, smeared zones between the sharp eddies
issues.fix: raise high-frequency cloud detail evenly across bands and cut the smudged transitions

issues.where: sunlit left and southern limb in crops F, G, H (also image-13.png sunlit limb, image-15.png crops L, P, Q, and image-16.png crop V top edge)
issues.what: Jupiter's sunlit edge is a jagged stair-stepped sphere cutoff wrapped in a pasted outer glow halo, and unoccluded background stars shine straight through the bright atmospheric haze and overlap the limb edge itself
issues.fix: supersample and anti-alias the planet limb, replace the additive bloom halo with a physically integrated atmospheric scattering falloff, and mask or attenuate background stars behind both the planet disc and dense limb glare

issues.where: moon in crop Q upper-right of the Great Red Spot (also image-13.png center and image-14.png crop A right edge)
issues.what: at native size the moon is visibly pixelated with a raw stair-stepped sunlit left edge, blocky surface blotches, and an airbrushed dark smudge directly beneath its south pole that reads as a fake 2D drop shadow
issues.fix: render the moon at higher supersampled resolution with clean anti-aliased limb edges and crisp surface detail, and remove the misplaced blurry drop-shadow smudge underneath it

issues.where: Jupiter cloud bands, Great Red Spot, and polar limbs in crops L and Q (also image-13.png globe and image-14.png crops A, G, H)
issues.what: the globe texture is soft, airbrushed, and under-resolved compared to the crisp 1-2 px background stars, smearing into muddy blur toward both poles while showing pixelated stair-stepping along diagonal creases like the upper-left rim of the Great Red Spot
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution cloud albedo/detail map with proper anisotropic filtering near the poles and limb so cloud filaments stay sharp at 1:1 pixel scale without upscale softness or jagged creases

issues.where: near-foreground clouds in crops S, T, U (also image-09.png bottom foreground and image-10.png crops E and H)
issues.what: the bottom-left foreground clouds in crop S and lower crop H dissolve into a soft, muddy generative smear with mushy orange/grey blobs, while the dark blue storm troughs in crop U and image-10.png crop E mix airbrushed cyan glow patches with isolated pixelated white/blue pinpoint dots on the clouds
issues.fix: render crisp near-field cloud detail (or physically consistent camera depth-of-field) instead of uneven foreground blur, and replace the airbrushed cyan blotches and stray pinpoint specks with coherent volumetric internal cloud lightning

issues.where: diagonal vortex cloud ridges and upper-right limb in crops B, C, E, G, I (also image-09.png and image-11.png crops Q, R)
issues.what: high-contrast diagonal cloud rims show crunchy oversharpened stair-stepped aliasing at native scale, the upper-right limb has a hard cyan rim line with blobby stars inside the blue atmospheric haze, and the Milky Way dust lanes carry blotchy color noise
issues.fix: reduce post-sharpening/upscale ringing with clean supersampling on diagonal cloud edges, soften the cyan limb line into a smooth atmospheric gradient that dims overlapping stars, and denoise the Milky Way background

issues.where: unlit nightside hemisphere and right limb in crop C (also image-15.png crops M and R)
issues.what: faint noisy blue patches and a dim bluish rim remain slightly visible on Jupiter's unlit nightside with minor dark-tone banding near the terminator
issues.fix: drop unlit nightside surface illumination cleanly to zero while still occluding background stars, and dither the terminator shadow falloff from 16-bit to eliminate dark-side blotches and banding
